name: Chrome & Circumstance
description: A Vantablack-produced reality competition in which twelve Tier 4 and Tier 5 contestants compete for romantic partnership selection from a single Tier 5 Spire executive, with the twist that all contestants must surrender their augmentations for the duration of filming — living 'as nature intended' in a luxury corponation retreat. The show's premise positions the removal of chrome as intimacy and vulnerability, a framing that drew immediate criticism from augmentation advocacy communities. Contestants who fare poorly in elimination rounds are described as 'returned to the market,' a phrase the production uses without apparent irony.
cultural_impact: The show accidentally made forced de-augmentation a mainstream cultural conversation, ultimately generating more support for augmentation rights than the advocacy communities had achieved in the previous five years.
story_hooks: One contestant smuggled a subdermal passive recording implant past the production's screening process and has footage of what happens off-camera.
The Spire executive at the show's center is using the production as cover for a series of undisclosed business meetings with the retreat's corporate owner.
A runner crew is hired to retrieve a piece of expensive chrome that a contestant was told was 'safely stored' — but the storage facility has no record of it.
